verdict.rationale: Lambda's own docs show instances come with Lambda Stack, a preinstalled set of AI/ML drivers, tools, and frameworks, on Ubuntu 22.04. There is also a selectable 'GPU Base' image, the API lets you pick a different base image, and JupyterLab comes preinstalled, so you don't build an environment from scratch. However, there is no evidence of a catalog of application templates like vLLM or ComfyUI, and PyTorch and CUDA are not explicitly named. Missing for 10: named PyTorch/CUDA image contents, vLLM and ComfyUI one-click templates, a browsable template catalog, and independent hands-on corroboration.
